```python
import numpy as np

routes = run.route_sets()
counts = np.diff(routes.set_offsets())  # the routes of each pair
pair = int(np.flatnonzero(counts >= 3)[0])  # the first pair with three or more
viz.map_route(routes, run.network, pair)
```
